lean_correspondence.definitions: Pinned Model.lean defines advection U x=fderiv U x (U x), ZeroAdvection V = forall t x, advection (V t) x=0, and force nu V = timeDerivative V - nu laplacian V.
lean_correspondence.construction: Pinned TorusSlowMain defines torusSlowVelocity=slowFromRest(loadedMachineVelocity ...); LoadedMachine defines loadedMachineVelocity=initializedProgram(...); SlowBundle uses initializedProgram_zero_advection; SlowProgram proves slowFromRest_zero_advection. Therefore every valid-input torusSlowVelocity is ZeroAdvection.
lean_correspondence.no_go: For any valid Lean input, literal same-coordinate equality torusSlowVelocity I hI = U_alpha1 is impossible, because the left side has ZeroAdvection and the right side has nonzero advection at Q_r for every t>=1. Even identifying only the raw force g_alpha1 with Lean's force of that same October velocity fails at Q_r.
lean_correspondence.scope: This excludes literal field/force identification on the common unit torus with the same time and coordinates. It does not exclude a separately proved coordinate/time transformation, another Lean construction, an independently formalized projected-pressure theorem, or equivalence of high-level computational decision properties.

local_symbolic_replay.method: Python SymPy local algebraic sanity replay; no Lean compiler or theorem replay.
local_symbolic_replay.script:
import sympy as s
X,Y,Z,p1,p2,eps,c0=s.symbols('X Y Z p1 p2 eps c0',real=True)
c=s.Function('c')(Z)
W=s.Matrix([c*(X-p1),-c*(Y-p2),1]); A=W.jacobian([X,Y,Z])*W
assert [s.simplify(z.subs({X:p1+eps,Y:p2,s.diff(c,Z):0,c:c0})) for z in A]==[c0**2*eps,0,0]
u=s.symbols('u',positive=True); E=lambda x:s.exp(-1/x)
beta=E(u)/(E(u)+E(1-u))
assert s.simplify(s.diff(beta,u,2).subs(u,s.Rational(1,2)))==0
